summary: ORIX Corporation filed a Form 6-K disclosing the status of its ongoing share repurchase program authorized by its Board on May 11, 2026. The program allows repurchase of up to 100 million common shares (approx. 9.1% of outstanding) for up to JPY 250 billion through March 31, 2027, via market purchases under a discretionary contract. As of May 31, 2026, ORIX had repurchased 1,693,600 shares for JPY 10,574,598,800. The filing provides periodic disclosure of repurchase progress. Watch for continued execution and potential EPS accretion.
